verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an agent framework and platform, so publishing an official MCP server that external agents can connect to is a fair question, and the axis applies. The only MCP evidence is the `mcps` field, which lets CrewAI agents consume MCP tools. That is client-side and does not show a CrewAI-provided MCP server. Nothing in the pack documents a first-party MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint.
